page_title: LEE 1-0 FUL | Leeds v Fulham 17/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Chris Kavanagh has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' Jonah Kusi Asare (Fulham) has tested the patience of referee Chris Kavanagh and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+4' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds) takes it short.
90+4' Substitution. Sebastiaan Bornauw (Leeds) in, Brenden Aaronson out.

90+3' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Bernd Leno pulls off a brilliant save.
90+1' 1 - 0 What a hit! Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot inside the left post. 1:0.
90+1' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' A dangerous towering header by Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
89' James Justin (Leeds) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
88' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Harry Wilson will be replaced by Issa Diop (Fulham).
88' Substitution. Jonah Kusi Asare (Fulham) replaces Raul Jimenez.
87' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Jorge Cuenca (Fulham) for his blatant foul.
86' Fulham keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
83' Pascal Struijk (Leeds) meets a cross inside the box, but he is unable to produce an accurate header and it goes just over the bar.
83' James Justin (Leeds) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
81' The substitution has been made. Lukas Nmecha (Leeds) has replaced Jayden Bogle.
81' Daniel Farke has decided to substitute Ilia Gruev and he is replaced by Ao Tanaka (Leeds).
80' Corner kick. James Justin (Leeds) is ready to send the ball into the box.
80' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.
79' Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
77' Problems for Marco Silva as Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Joshua King replaces him.
76' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
76' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:1.
73' James Justin (Leeds) launches a cross from the corner, but Bernd Leno is alert to thwart the effort.
70' It's time for a substitution. Wilfried Gnonto (Leeds) comes on in place of Noah Okafor.
69' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort high over the bar.
66' Tom Cairney (Fulham) comes onto the pitch because Sasa Lukic simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
65' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Ryan Sessegnon is replaced by Kevin (Fulham).
65' The game is interrupted now, Sasa Lukic (Fulham) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
63' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes well past the left post.
61' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
60' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
58' CHANCE! Brenden Aaronson finds Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the right post!
58' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
56' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Harry Wilson (Fulham) was quite harsh and Chris Kavanagh didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
55' Harry Wilson (Fulham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
53' A pass by Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
51' Harry Wilson (Fulham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
51' James Justin (Leeds) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Chris Kavanagh no option but to blow his whistle. A free kick to Fulham.
50' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
50' Fulham players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
47' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
46' Joe Rodon (Leeds) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' James Justin (Leeds) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Ryan Sessegnon (Fulham) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
45' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) prepares to take a corner kick.
44' Bernd Leno displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Jayden Bogle (Leeds) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
41' Ethan Ampadu (Leeds) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
40' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
38' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
35' Karl Darlow pulls off a fantastic save! Sasa Lukic (Fulham) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out.
33' One of the players from Fulham times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
30' 48:52 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
28' Referee Chris Kavanagh has finally had enough of Marco Silva and brandishes a yellow card at him!
28' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
28' Ilia Gruev (Leeds) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
27' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Chris Kavanagh had an easy-decision to make.
24' Jayden Bogle plays a beautiful lofted pass to Brenden Aaronson (Leeds), who somehow crashes the ball miles over the bar from a promising position.
21' Noah Okafor (Leeds) zig-zags his way into the box and fails to direct a shot inside the left post. The goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop.
20' Ilia Gruev (Leeds) swings in a cross from the corner, but Bernd Leno reads it well and gathers the ball.
19' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) picks out Ryan Sessegnon with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
18' Brenden Aaronson (Leeds) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
15' The ball rebounds to Noah Okafor (Leeds) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
13' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
12' Fulham hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
10' A precise low pass is received by Harry Wilson (Fulham), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post.
8' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) times his run into the box perfectly and slams a header goalwards from the centre of the box, but it lacks accuracy and flies well wide of the left post.
8' Harry Wilson (Fulham) steps up to send the ball in.
7' That didn't go as planned! Noah Okafor (Leeds) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Bernd Leno, who easily kept it out.
7' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham).

5' Ryan Sessegnon almost found himself in a promising position after Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
3' Pascal Struijk (Leeds) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
2' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle. Joachim Andersen (Fulham) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick has been awarded to Leeds.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Fulham will have the kick-off.
